sentences.text: Alvin and the Chipmunks is a 2007 American live-action/computer animated musical family comedy film directed by Tim Hill .	Tim Hill	Tim Hill (director)	Alvin and the Chipmunks	Alvin and the Chipmunks	live-action	live-action	computer animated	computer animation	musical	musical film	family	Family film	comedy film	comedy film

Based on the characters of the same name created by Ross Bagdasarian , Sr. , the film stars Jason Lee , David Cross , and Cameron Richardson with the voices of Justin Long , Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney .	Ross Bagdasarian	Ross Bagdasarian, Sr.	Jason Lee	Jason Lee (actor)	David Cross	David Cross	Cameron Richardson	Cameron Richardson	Justin Long	Justin Long	Matthew Gray Gubler	Matthew Gray Gubler	Jesse McCartney	Jesse McCartney	the characters of the same name	Alvin and the Chipmunks

It was released worldwide on December 14 , 2007 by 20th Century Fox and produced by Fox 2000 Pictures , Regency Enterprises and Bagdasarian Company .	20th Century Fox	20th Century Fox	Regency Enterprises	Regency Enterprises	Fox 2000 Pictures	20th Century Fox

Alvin and the Chipmunks grossed $ 217 million in North America and $ 361 million at the box office worldwide on a budget of $ 60 million and was the seventh-best-selling DVD of 2008 , earning over $ 101 million .	Alvin and the Chipmunks	Alvin and the Chipmunks	North America	North America

The first film in the film series , Alvin and the Chipmunks was followed by three sequels : Alvin and the Chipmunks : The Squeakquel , released on December 23 , 2009 , Alvin and the Chipmunks : Chipwrecked , released on December 16 , 2011 and Alvin and the Chipmunks : The Road Chip , released on December 18 , 2015 .
